findings.location: Opening Scripture quotation (1 Corinthians 13:8); also heading “d.)”
findings.source_quote: “Charity never faileth” / “It never faileth, because God is the source of it.”
findings.suggested_fix: Replace “प्रेम कभी टलता नहीं” with “प्रेम कभी असफल नहीं होता” in both places. The current wording says love is never delayed or avoided, rather than that it never fails.
findings.translation_quote: “प्रेम कभी टलता नहीं” / “वह कभी टलता नहीं, क्योंकि उसका स्रोत परमेश्वर है।”

findings.suggested_fix: Use a Hindi rendering that conveys a godly household/home, such as “परमेश्वर-भक्त घर-परिवार” or “भक्तिमय गृहस्थी,” rather than “धार्मिक परिवार.”
